items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I started working with a bass player out of Columbus, Ohio, named Tweed(?) Beard. And we had a very good group going.

ctx.x: But he was... My uncle, I must say again, he was very beautiful to me, and his wife, Lydia, was very beautiful. They had a daughter named Greta. The whole time I stayed with them, they never charged me a penny for anything. And I was out working and making money. They wouldn't let me spend anything, you know. They were so great to me -- and anybody else from the family who wanted to take a shot at Detroit. We had really great times together.

So I brought my grandmother back. And I came back, and things had changed around a little bit. I started working with a bass player out of Columbus, Ohio, named Tweed(?) Beard. And we had a very good group going.
